mechanism: Added one new producer-auth gate (trigger2_observed_evidence_producer_auth_gate_v1.py) plus its producer (trigger2_observed_evidence_producer_v1.py) plus its authority (TRIGGER2_OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_PRODUCER_AUTHORITY_V1.json), reusing the exact recomputation pattern already established by the A02 discriminator producer and the generation-provenance gate. _validate_observation_receipt in the retained state-history proof gate now calls this new gate instead of only checking loosely-typed nonempty strings.

negative_controls_required_by_source_doc: reused receipt id with changed payload -> test_observed_event_reused_receipt_id_with_changed_observed_value_fails_closed
empirical_closure_evidence.note_wrong_policy_digest_case: not separately testable as a distinct failure mode: policy is loaded whole from the one authority file and hashed as part of the receipt preimage, so any policy field mutation is already covered by the wrong-admission-id/generation and stale-producer-hash tests -- there is no separate 'policy digest' field a caller could independently forge without also failing one of those.

regression_check.method: same targeted pytest sweep used for Phase 3, run again after this change
regression_check.conclusion: zero regressions; +8 net new passing tests (7 new + updated happy-path replacing the old naive one); the 97 failures remain the same pre-existing, unrelated set

v4_composition_update: tools/trigger2_hyperposition_state_history_generation_bound_gate_v4.py remaining_p0 item 'OBSERVED evidence producer authentication is required before OBSERVED positives' moved to closed_p0.

hypothesis_and_implications.hypothesis: The gap existed because OBSERVED-typed evidence was originally only checked for STRUCTURAL well-formedness (schema, digest binding, zero-credit fences, nonempty strings) since those were the properties the discriminator/replay-integrity work cared about first. Producer identity authentication was never actually needed until now because no real external observation source was wired in yet -- the gap was latent, not exploited, but would have silently admitted fabricated observations the moment any real OBSERVED pipeline existed.
hypothesis_and_implications.implication_for_real_observation_sources: This closure only authenticates a SINGLE pinned synthetic pilot admission scope (T2_OBS_ADMISSION_SYNTHETIC_PILOT_V1, generation 1). Before any REAL external observation source (a live DB, an API, a sensor) can mint OBSERVED evidence, it needs its own registered admission_id + generation in the SAME authority file (or a generalized admission-registry mechanism if sources proliferate) -- this was intentionally scoped to the minimal synthetic case to avoid building unused infrastructure ahead of actual demand, matching the same choice made in Phase 3.
hypothesis_and_implications.implication_for_generation_over_time: admission 'generation' is a monotonic counter field, not yet wired to any rotation/expiry logic. If admission scopes are meant to expire or rotate (e.g. per training epoch), that lifecycle needs to be designed before this becomes the real ingestion path -- right now generation=1 is permanently valid with no expiry.
hypothesis_and_implications.risk_flagged_not_fixed: the OBSERVATION_RECEIPT_SCHEMA field 'observed_time' is bound into the receipt preimage (so it can't be silently swapped after minting) but is NOT independently verified against any real clock or freshness window -- a producer could still mint a receipt today claiming an arbitrary past or future observed_time and it would authenticate cleanly. If replay-freshness matters later, that needs a separate mechanism (e.g. binding to a monotonic admission-generation counter's issuance window), out of scope for this closure.
